mechanism: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist

analogy.mechanism: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist
analogy.rationale: GABA-A receptor subunits are barely expressed in these cell lines, so an inverse agonist at the benzodiazepine site should produce little to no transcriptional response; other GABA/benzodiazepine-site classes are the closest analogs but also act on the same poorly expressed receptor.
